title: VPC delta-upgrade contract and passive-traffic quiesce specification
creator: Maya Patel
description: Define an operational contract and acceptance criteria for performing incremental (delta) control-plane upgrades in Private/VPC deployments without requiring full cluster egress. The contract focuses on a passive traffic quiesce phase, deterministic artifact validation, KMS key handoff validation, and a minimal-allowed-egress checklist for sites operating in heavily restricted networks or air-gapped environments.
background: Customers with strict networking constraints ask for upgrade paths that avoid large artifact pulls and limit outbound connections. Existing upgrade PRDs emphasize offline mirrors and operator reboots, but lack a concise contract for a delta upgrade flow that can be executed with a short passive window and deterministic rollback triggers. This ticket captures requirements, acceptance gates, and a test matrix for the delta upgrade flow.
goals: Define the minimum egress surface required for a delta control-plane upgrade (quiesce window <= 10 minutes)
Specify deterministic artifact validation and checksum reconciliation steps usable in air-gapped modes
Describe KMS/HSM rotation validation and key handoff safety checks during upgrades
Establish observable SLOs and rollback triggers for the passive quiesce phase
scope_included: Control-plane image diff upgrades (minor patch sets, no major schema migrations)
Passive traffic quiesce procedure and timing contract
Checksum-based artifact validation and operator hooks for offline mirrors
Telemetry hooks and console-visible upgrade state transitions
scope_excluded: Full cluster reboots or major database migrations
Automated image distribution mechanisms (outside the operator's offline mirror responsibilities)
Application-layer schema changes that require customer-side migrations
requirements: Upgrade controller must accept a delta bundle manifest instead of full image pulls
Operator provides explicit 'prepare-quiesce' API that returns estimated quiesce duration and affected routes
Each delta bundle includes SHA256 checksums for all artifacts; operator validates against local mirror before applying
KMS rotation step must be no-touch if customer has pre-staged keys; otherwise operator aborts with clear remediation steps
Upgrade must expose a progress trace with tokenized checkpoints surfaced in Console (percent complete, artifacts validated, quiesce started/stopped)
Fallback: automatic immediate rollback if >20% of production routes return 5xx during quiesce period or if artifact validation fails
acceptance_criteria: Simulated air-gapped environment upgrade completes using only pre-staged mirror artifacts; operator logs show successful checksum validation
Passive quiesce time remains <= 10 minutes in the 75th-percentile test across our regression harness for small control-plane deltas
KMS handoff path test: when pre-staged keys are missing, operator aborts and emits remediation playbook link in Console and logs
Rollforward observable: Console shows a consistent state transition sequence for at least three successful delta upgrades in staging (prepare -> quiesce -> apply -> verify)
Rollback trigger validation: inject 5xx errors during quiesce and verify automatic rollback occurs and metrics are emitted to the SLO dashboard
rollout_plan: Design: finalize contract and playbooks with Security and SRE (2 weeks)
Implementation: operator changes to accept delta bundle manifests and prepare-quiesce API (ENG cycle 46)
Staging tests: run end-to-end harness in isolated lab with mirrors and KMS emulation (3 runs pass)
Gradual customer canary: offer opt-in to 3 existing Private customers with low-change windows and run monitored canary (2 weeks)
GA: enable as an opt-in toggle in Console and document operator pre-requisites
test_plan: Unit tests for manifest parsing and checksum validation
Integration: operator applies delta bundle against mirrored artifacts in isolated network (no egress)
Chaos: during quiesce inject network partition and 5xx responses to validate rollback
Telemetry: verify Console events and traces are emitted for each checkpoint
Performance: measure quiesce duration across a matrix of mirror latencies and bundle sizes
